from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

wt = Path("/Users/steventran/.do_again/selfdev-20261007")
expected = "f108fa2765a922f800c9cc87e99eab11b629839e"
head = subprocess.check_output(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"], cwd=wt, text=True).strip()
status = subprocess.check_output(["git","status","--porcelain=v1"], cwd=wt, text=True).strip()
if head != expected or status:
    raise SystemExit(f"unexpected worktree state head={head} status={status!r}")

targets = [
    wt/"src/do_again/cli.py",
    wt/"src/do_again/service/runtime.py",
    wt/"tests/test_cli.py",
    wt/"tests/test_service.py",
]
needles = ("SETUP_OK", "setup", "verify", "browser_enabled", "run_iteration_test", "self-test", "status")

for p in targets:
    if not p.exists():
        continue
    print(f"=== {p.relative_to(wt)} ===")
    lines = p.read_text().splitlines()
    hits = [i for i,l in enumerate(lines,1) if any(n in l for n in needles)]
    seen=set()
    for hit in hits:
        start=max(1,hit-6); end=min(len(lines),hit+20)
        if (start,end) in seen: continue
        seen.add((start,end))
        print(f"--- {start}-{end} ---")
        for n in range(start,end+1):
            print(f"{n:04d}: {lines[n-1]}")
